data.narrative:
Asimov is a Series B biotech company that has raised $209M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics) and 3 public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($209M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage progression, implies a valuation of $397M. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences, Series C). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to lack of disclosed revenue data.

The triangulated valuation range is $338M to $4.0B, with a median of $1.9B based on the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding stage progression within the peer set and the substantial valuation spread among Series C peers. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue trajectory relative to peers, competitive positioning within the biotech sector, and capital efficiency relative to the stage-appropriate benchmark.
